description.it: Generatori della Angular CLI dei workspace Angular (component, service, guard… e quelli di Material, NgRx) con un form dalle loro opzioni e l'anteprima dei file prima di scriverli; ng add e ng update
description.en: Angular CLI generators of the Angular workspaces (component, service, guard… and those of Material, NgRx) with a form from their options and a preview of the files before they are written; ng add and ng update

description.it: Versione della CLI, generatori rapidi e quelli usati di recente nel progetto
description.en: CLI version, quick generators and the ones used recently in the project

tools.name: workspaces
tools.description: List the Angular workspaces among Kelbo's projects (those with angular.json): applications and libraries, Angular CLI and @angular/core versions installed in the project, whether node_modules is installed.

tools.name: generators
tools.description: List the Angular CLI generators (schematics) available in a workspace — @schematics/angular and the other installed collections such as Angular Material or NgRx — with their options (name, type, choices, default, description). The positional option (usually the name) is given separately.

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Run an Angular CLI generator (ng generate) in a workspace with the project's own CLI. Without apply it is a dry run: it returns the files that would be created or updated and any conflicts, writing nothing. With apply: true, and only when the dry run is clean, it writes the files and returns them.

schematic.description: Schematic name or alias: component, service, guard, pipe…

name.description: Value of the positional option, usually the name with an optional path (features/orders/order-list)

workspaceProject.description: Application or library of the workspace (angular.json projects); the default one when omitted

options.description: Other options of the schematic, by name (see angular_cli_generators)

apply.description: Write the files; false (default) only previews them

folder.description: Folder where the files go, relative to the workspace root (e.g. src/app/features/orders); the project's default folder (src/app) when omitted. The name can still carry sub-folders.
